s: puM, (mas parimARe + BAve GaY .) mAzaparimARam । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH । mAzA iti BAzA ॥ (masyate parimIyate asAvanenaveti mas + GaY .) ataH sAMvatsaraM SrAdDaM karttavyaM mAsacihnitam ॥ mAsacihnantu karttavyaM pOzamAGAdyameva hi । yatastatra viDAnena sa mAsaH parikIrttitaH ॥” iti laGuhArItaH ॥ kArttikAdidbAdaSasaMjYako'pi । yaTA, -- “antyopAntyO triBO jYeyO PAlgunaSca triBo mataH । SezA mAsA dviBA jYeyAH kfttikAdivyavasTayA ॥” sa ca cEtrAdidbAdaSasaMjYakaSca । yaTA vyaktaM brahmapurARam । “cEtre mAsi jagadbrahmA sasarjja praTame'hani । Suklapakze samagrantu tadA sUryyodaye sati ॥ pravarttayAmAsa tadA kAlasya gaRanAmapi । grahAnrASInftUn mAsAn vatsarAn vatsarADipAn । ityanena mAsarttuvatsarARAM cAndratvamuktam । brahmasidDAnte'pi । “cEtrasitAderudayAdBAnorvvarzarttumAsayugakalpAH । sfzwyAdO laNkAyAmiha pravfttA dinErvvatsa ॥” cEtrasitAdeScEtraSuklapratipadastAmAraByetyarTaH ॥ api ca । “mInAdisTo raviryezAmAramBapraTamakzaRe । Bavette'bde cAndramAsAScEtrAdyA dvAdaSa smftAH ॥” cAndrasAvanasOranAkzatraBedena sa ca caturvviDaH । SuklapratipadAdidarSAntaScAndraH । tatra cAndro'pi dviviDaH । SuklapratipadAdidarSAnto muKyaH । kfzRapratipadAdipOrRamAsyanto gORaH । yatkiYcittriMSattiTyAtmakaSceti dviviDo gORaH । triMSadahorAtrAtmakaH sAvanaH । AdityEkarASiBogAvacCinnaH sOraH । saptaviMSatinakzatrAvacCinnastriMSannAkzatradinAtmakaSca nAkzatraH । taTA ca brahmasidDAnte । “cAndraH SuklAdidarSAntaH sAvanastriMSatA dinEH । ekarASO raviryAvat kAlaM mAsaH saMBAskaraH ॥ sarvvarkzaparivarttEstu nAkzatra iti cocyate ॥” sUryyasidDAnte । “nAqIzazwyA tu nAkzatramahorAtraM pracakzate । tattriMSatA BavenmAsaH sAvano'rkodayEstaTA ॥ EndavastiTiBistadvat saMkrAntyA sOra ucyate ॥” tattriMSatA nAkzatradinatriMSatA mAso nAkzatramAsaH । taTA triMSatA ॥ * ॥ smArttaSUlapARimate muKyacAndra eva mAsapadaSakyaH । jImUtavAhanamate sOra eva SakyaH । cAndrapramARaM prAguktam । sOrapramARantu । sOrAstu mAGAdayo dbAdaSa eva SrOtAH । taTA ca SrutiH । tapastapasyO SESirAvftuH । maDuSca mADavaSca vAsantikAvftuH । SukraSca SuciSca grEzmAvftuH । aTEtadudagayanaM devAnAM dinam । naBASca naBasyaSca vArzikAvftuH । izaSca UrjjaSca SAradAvftuH । sahASca sahasyaSca hEmantikAvftuH । aTEtaddakziRAyanaM devAnAM rAtririti । atrAyanasya sOratvena tadGawakatapastapasyAdInAmapi sOra parateti । ato BUyasAmanuroDena vESAKAdayaH sOravAcino'vaDAryyante । iti malamAsatattvam ॥ api ca । “mezasTityA ravermAso vESAKo'bdamuKaH smftaH .” iti saNketakOmudI ॥ aTa karmmaviSeze mAsaviSezAdiH । tatra pitAmahaH । “Abdike pitfkftye ca mAsaScAndramasaH smftaH । vivAhAdO smftaH sOro yajYAdO sAvano mataH ॥” praTamAdipadaM yAtrAgrahacAraparam । yat karmma sUryyaBogyarASyulleKena yacca viSizyodagayanAdi vihitaM tatparaYca ayanasya sOramAsaGawitattvAt । tacca cUqopanayanAdi । dbitIyAdipadaM satraBftivfdbiprAyaScittAyurdAyASOcagarBADAnapuMsavanasImantonnayananAmakaraRAnnaprASananizkramaRacUqAdiparam । taTA ca vizRuDarmmottare । “aDvAyanaYca grahacArakarmma sOreRa mAsena sadADyavasyet । satrARyupAsyAnyaTa sAvanena lOkyaYca yat syAdvyavahArakarmma ॥” aDvAyanaM aDvagamanaM yAtreti yAvat ॥ * ॥ aTa sOrAdimAsavihitakarmmARi । “vivAhotsavayajYezu sOraM mAsaM praSasyate । pArvvaRe tvazwakASrAdDe cAndramizwaM taTAbdike ॥” atra yajYapadamudagayanAdivihitapaSuyAgABiprAyaM pitAmahoktantu vizRuDarmmottaroktasatraparam । gargaH । “AyurdAyaviBAgaSca prAyaScittakriyA taTA । sAvanena tu karttavyA mantrARAmapyupAsanA ॥” sUryyasidDAnte । “sUtakAdiparicCedo dinamAsAbdapAstaTA । maDyamagrahaBuktiSca sAvanena prakIrttitA ॥” maDyamagrahaBuktirjyotirgaRanA prasidDA ॥ * ॥ nAkzatramAsaprayojanaM vizRuDarmmottare । “nakzatrasatrARyayanAni cendormmAsena kuryyAdBagaRAtmakena .” nakzatrasatrARi mAsasADyayAgaviSezarUpARi yAjYikaprasidDAni । indorayanAni somAyanAKyasatrARi । iti samayaprakASaH ॥ evaM janmanakzatre SaniBOmavAre PalaM nAkzatramAsena yogyatvAt । yaTA, malamAsatattve । “janmanyfkze yadi syAtAM vArO BOmaSanEScarO । sa mAsaH kalmazo nAma manoduHKapradAyakaH ॥” malamAsavivaraRaM malamAsaSabde drazwavyam ॥ * ॥ aTa mAsakftyam । “AzAQaSuklEkAdaSyAM kuryyAt svApaM mahotsavam । AzAQe ca raTaM kuryyAt SrAvaRe SravaRAviDim ॥ BAdre ca janmadivase upavAsaparo Bavet । prasuptaYca pArivarttamASvine mAsi kArayet ॥ utTAnaM SrIhareH kuryyAdanyaTA vizRudrohakft । SuBe cEvASvine mAsi mahAmAyAYca pUjayet ॥ kArttike mAsi yat kftyaM SfRu devi varAnane ! । saptavarttyAH pramARena dIpaH syAccaturaNgulaH ॥ pakzAnte ca prakarttavyA dIpamAlA baliH SuBA । mArgaSIrze site pakze zazWIYca sitavastrakEH ॥ pUjayejjagadISaYca tUlavastrErviSezataH । pOze puRyABizekaYca praBo ! ॥ karpUrAkftidravyARi GftAktAni nivedayet । brAhmaRAn BojayedBaktyA devadevapuraHsTitAn ॥ aByarccya BagavadBaktyA dvijAMSca BagavadDiyA । ekasmin Bojite Bakte kowirBavati BaktitaH ॥ m: मास m. (or n., Siddh.) the moon (see पूर्ण-म्˚)

a month or the 12th part of the Hindū year (there are 4 kinds of months, viz. the solar, सौर; the natural, सावन; the stellar, नाक्षत्र, and the lunar, चान्द्र; the latter, which is the most usual and consists of 30 Tithis, being itself of two kinds as reckoned from the new or full moon, cf. IW. 179; for the names of the months see ib. 173 n. 3), RV. &c. &c. (मासम्, for a month; मासम् एकम्, for one month; मासेन, in the course of a month; मासे, in a m˚ = after the lapse of a m˚)
a symbolical N. for the number ‘twelve’, Sūryas.
a: मासः, --सं — [मा एव अण्] 1 A month; (it may be चांद्र, सौर, सावन, नाक्षत्र or बार्हस्पत्य); न मासे प्रतिपत्तासे मां चेन्मर्तासि मैथिलि Bk. 8. 95. --2 The moon (Ved.). --3 The number ‘twelve’. --Comp. --अनुमासिक a. monthly. --अंतः the day of new moon. --अवधिक a. lasting for or occurring in a month. --आहार a. eating only once a month. --उपवासिनी {1} a woman who fasts for a whole month. {2} a procuress, a lascivious or lewd woman (ironically). --कालिक a. monthly, lasting for a month. --जात a. a month old, born a month ago. --ज्ञः a kind of gallinule. --देय a. to be paid in a month. --प्रमितः the new-moon, --प्रवेशः the beginning of a month --मानः a year.

m: मास—संचयिक mfn. having provisions for a m˚, Mn. vi, 18.
मास—स्तोम m. N. of an Ekāha, ŚāṅkhŚr.
मास—ताला f. pl. (prob.) those parts of a calf skin from which the parchment stretched at the end of drums is made, MBh.
मास—तम mf(ई)n. forming or completing a m˚, Pāṇ. v, 2, 57.
मास—त्रयावधि ind. for the space of three m˚, Kathās.
मास—त्रय n. three m˚
मास—तुल्य mfn. equal to a m˚ or to a number of m˚, MW.
मास—वर्तिका f. a species of wagtail (= सर्षपी), L.
मासेश्वर-फल n. N. of wk.
मासि-श्राद्ध n. (fr. loc. of 2. मास् + श्˚) a Śrāddha or oblation to deceased ancestors performed every month, ĀpGṛ.
मासिकान्न n. food offered monthly to deceased progenitors, Mn. xi, 157.
मासिकार्थ-वत् mfn. happening or being done every month, Viṣṇ.

m: मासिक mf(ई)n. relating to or connected with a month (see माघ-म्˚)
monthly (i.e. ‘happening every month’, or ‘lasting for a m˚’ or ‘performed within a m˚’ &c.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
payable in a month (as a debt), Pāṇ. iv, 3, 47, Sch.
engaged for a m˚ (as a teacher), ib. v, 1, 80, Sch.
dedicated to a partic. month (as an oblation), ib. iv, 2, 34, Sch.
मासिक n. (with or scil. श्रद्ध) a partic. Śrāddha or oblation to deceased ancestors performed every new moon, Mn. v, 140 &c.
a: मासिक — a. (की f.) [म से भवः ठञ्] 1 Relating to a month. --2 Happening every month, monthly. --3 Lasting for a month. --4 Payable in a month. --5 Engaged for a month. --कं A funeral rite or Śrāddha performed every newmoon (during the first year of a man's death); पितॄणां मासिकं श्राद्धमन्वाहार्यं विदुर्बुधाः.
